children: Impact filed a Form F-4 registration statement tied to its proposed merger with Zoar Limited, marking a key milestone toward closing.
Zoar Limited filed a Form F-4 with the SEC that includes a preliminary proxy statement/prospectus for the proposed merger.
Impact management calls the registration filing a major milestone on the path to completing the business combination.
Closing remains subject to SEC effectiveness, Impact stockholder approval, NYSE American listing approval, and other closing conditions.
Post-merger PubCo is expected to focus on development and supply of active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates.
